theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid N → Euclid P) (c : Euclid N) (r m : ℝ), MeasurableSet M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[N] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ContDiff ℝ 1 g → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ ball c r, ∀ b ∈ ball c r, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖g a - g b‖) → MeasurableSet (g '' ball c r) → μHE[N] (g '' ball c r) ≠ ∞ → ∃ E : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet E ∧ μHE[N] E = 0 ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball c r, g y ∈ M → g y ∉ E → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt N M (g y) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ g y : Euclid N →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
